seo.title: Priceline: agentic assistant Penny - nearly 10 minutes saved per trip (2026)
seo.meta_description: Penny, Priceline's AI travel agent that went agentic in 2026 on Claude, saves nearly 10 minutes per trip and shows higher engagement and conversion.
seo.resume_citable: In 2026, Priceline made its Penny agent fully agentic on the Claude models; travelers who use it save on average nearly 10 minutes per trip and convert more.

faq.a: An AI travel agent that understands a complex request, compares price and availability in real time, and lets travelers book without leaving the conversation.
Anthropic's Claude models for reasoning, the Priceline stack on Google Cloud, and OpenAI for voice.

stack_technique.detail: Claude models for Penny's conversational reasoning and agentic planning (multi-city comparison, trade-offs).
Real-time voice block for Penny's voice interface.
Deals engine, traveler preference memory, real-time inventory and pricing, booking flow integrated into the conversation.

objectif_business: Move travel search from a stack of filters and tabs to a single conversation where the traveler describes their need and the agent compares, weighs trade-offs, and books.
description: Penny is Priceline's AI travel agent. In 2026 it becomes agentic: it understands a complex request (comparing flights to several cities over a given week), evaluates price and availability live, surfaces the trade-offs, and lets travelers book without leaving the conversation. The reasoning relies on Anthropic's Claude models on the Priceline stack hosted on Google Cloud, with OpenAI for voice. Priceline positions Penny on preference memory and its deals technology, not just the model.

resultats.metrique: Average time saved per trip, vs contacting customer service
Engagement and conversion of Penny users

niveau_preuve.justification: The official transcript of the Booking Holdings earnings call of 28 April 2026, published on the group's investor site (S4), contains word for word the increase observed among Penny users versus non-users, and CEO Glenn Fogel confirms there a conversion gain during the Q&A. The primary document replaces the press coverage on this point. Caveat to keep in mind: the earnings call describes the gain without quantifying it and speaks of a very small sample; the figure for time saved per trip remains, for its part, a brand claim (Priceline press release).

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real-time on every conversation, with continuous evaluation of price and availability.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Priceline's AI Experiences team, on an in-house stack hosted on Google Cloud.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The expressed travel intent, crossed with live inventory and pricing and the traveler's preference memory. Without a reliable price and availability feed, the proposed trade-offs become wrong and conversion drops.

etapes.detail: The traveler describes their trip, including complex multi-destination requests, by text or voice.
The agent plans, queries inventory, and compares options across several cities and dates.
It surfaces price, availability, and compromises, drawing on preference memory and Priceline deals.
The traveler confirms and pays without leaving the conversation.

prerequis_data: real-time inventory and pricing via API
replication.premiere_etape: Connect a conversational assistant to inventory for a narrow use case (flight comparison), then add in-thread booking.

playbook.action: Frame a narrow use case (flight comparison) and connect a conversational assistant to inventory and pricing via API.
playbook.livrable: Conversational prototype that answers with real inventory data.

playbook.action: Add per-user preference memory and trade-off presentation (price, availability, compromises).
playbook.livrable: Agent able to compare several cities and dates with persisted preferences.

playbook.action: Integrate booking and payment into the conversation thread, with payment compliance (PSD2/SCA in the EU).
playbook.livrable: Transactional booking flow accessible without leaving the conversation.

playbook.action: Add the real-time voice block and open a beta to a group of users.
playbook.livrable: Voice interface in beta with measurement of time saved per trip.

playbook.action: Compare agent users to non-users (engagement, conversion, customer-service contacts) and generalize.
playbook.livrable: Quantified read vs the classic journey and a full rollout plan.

replication.equipe: 1 AI PM + 3-5 devs (inventory API, conversational front end, payment) + 1 ML/prompt engineer + payment and GDPR legal.

statut_vivant.note: Agentic version announced in June 2026, with a switch of the reasoning engine to Claude; product live on the site and app.

transposable_ue.note: An agentic booking agent is transposable, but the use of voice and preference memory requires in the EU a GDPR legal basis, AI disclosure (AI Act), and consent for voice recording. In-thread payment integrations require PSD2 / SCA compliance.
